other_conditions: All members of partnership firms or co‑operative societies must belong to the Scheduled Caste community
Annual family income of each member/applicant must not exceed ₹3,00,000
Loans are limited to units costing up to ₹1,40,000 (maximum loan amount ₹1.25 lakhs)
Applicants must apply through State Channelizing Agencies or other authorized Channelizing Agencies; direct contact with NSFDC is not permitted
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to 90% of project cost (maximum ₹1.25 lakhs) at 2.5% interest to SC applicants for income‑generating activities, repayable over three years.
